# Integration authorization record

On 2026-11-13 the XECKernelPro maintainer stated in the project session that
Oh My Keymint's author had agreed to integration and explicitly instructed us
to proceed. This records the maintainer's authorization statement; it is not
a quotation of the author's private correspondence or an independent legal
verification of that correspondence.

The private screenshot remains outside the repository. No private conversation,
account identifier, or contact details are distributed here.

Integration scope: package the unmodified 1.2.6-9069c6c ARM64 upstream engine
as a separate executable/payload with XECKernelPro's own lifecycle scripts.
Preserve General License Agreement v4, the Oh My Keymint License, AOSP notices,
upstream attribution and source/release links. Do not relicense the upstream
